dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Treating friends and family? Look no further than Wanmin Restaurant!

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Our renowned chefs bring you the very best with every bite.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: And our waiting staff love to provide service with a smile!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner? It's always cooking at Wanmin Restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: You'll be delighted by our hearty meals at affordable prices.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: So treat yourself to our home cooking, any time of the day.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hungry for change? Discover new flavors at Wanmin Restaurant!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Our diverse menu is sure to have a dish with your name on it.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Why settle for less when you could be feasting like an adeptus?
